purpose: Defines the fields, preconditions, and structure of the 'Medication Order Review' screen within workflow WF_003.
preconditions: An active medication order exists for the patient
postconditions: All required fields on 'Medication Order Review' are captured and saved before advancing to the next screen.
validations: Confirm the order has been pharmacist-verified before it appears on this screen
